name: Gwen
tagline: Gwen Reserve: $2,140 a year back at the restaurants, venues, hotels and services you already love.
description: Gwen is a card company. Its one card, Gwen Reserve, is a metal Visa Infinite card with a $695 annual fee and seven credits worth $2,140 a year: dining at 1,400 partner restaurants, concert and game tickets, streaming, a 900-hotel collection, travel, a partner store you pick, and wellness. Members earn 5x points on travel booked through Gwen, 3x on dining, tickets and streaming, and 1x on everything else.
